bagPolicy.summary: The venue operates a no-bag policy with an exception for bags smaller than 10 × 7 × 2 inches, which are inspected. Backpacks are prohibited; paid lockers remain available until 45 minutes after the event.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Miami Tower Garage at 100 SE 2nd Street has a $20 special-event parking rate set by the Miami Parking Authority; the venue does not manage the garage.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue Know Before You Go page covers transit and parking but does not specify an app-based rideshare point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Outside food and drinks are prohibited. The venue’s FAQ does not publish a fixed concession menu.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The venue arrival and FAQ pages do not give a specific accessible concert entrance or seating procedure.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: No re-entry is allowed after leaving the venue.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Tickets are displayed from a Ticketmaster account or added to a digital wallet; screenshots and printouts are not accepted.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Show the live ticket barcode on a phone and use the posted general admission or reserved seating entrance. Bags and guests are subject to inspection.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
